However, the document notes that this same training process leads to 'hallucinations' where models generate factually incorrect information. Accelerationists must reconcile this performance-reliability gap if AI is to be a reliable engine for scientific discovery.

factual_claims.claim: Nearly two-thirds of citations generated by GPT-4o in the study were either entirely fabricated or contained bibliographic errors.
The fabrication rate for citations in the study was 6 percent for major depressive disorder, 28 percent for binge eating disorder, and 29 percent for body dysmorphic disorder.
For the specialized review on binge eating disorder, the fabrication rate was 46 percent, compared to 17 percent for the general overview.
